args.summary: Session summary: The bronze open-field battle stalled. Both armies stayed at 100% health and the match ended in Defeat by timeout at 20 minutes with 0 men lost on either side. The attack-move and radial menu were confusing, and units clumped at my camp. Info panels and the top bar cover a lot of the 390 px height, and units are tiny. The tutorial overlays were cramped. The result screen is clear. The powers menu works, but the arm banner lingers over the field. I did not see naval in this setup. The setup screen is usable. Overall the fun was low because the fight never really started.

thought: Back at setup after a stalemate; wrapping up.
